name: Earth Giant
motion: Slow breathing and moss/head shift; large alternating strides and strong planted weight
action: Arm raises and delivers a broad strike; heavy recoil; knees buckle and the body settles into a rock mound
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PIXEL ART animation sheet for Earth Giant. Use ONLY row 2, column 4 of supplied atlas for exact identity: huge EARTH GIANT made of BROWN angular stone blocks with green moss on head/shoulders/chest, amber eyes, broad stone fists and two heavy stone legs, NO crown. Preserve body plan, silhouette, face and palette.
Exactly SIXTEEN full-body poses in a FOUR-COLUMN FOUR-ROW equal square grid. Same RIGHT-facing slight top-down three-quarter camera, palette, head/body scale and pixel size in all cells. Genuine coarse 16-bit RPG PIXEL ART: author at native48x48 logical pixels per cell and enlarge NEAREST NEIGHBOR. Hard chunky square clusters, dark stepped outlines and a small flat-color palette. No smooth digital painting, tiny brush texture, gradients, antialiasing, blur, bloom or subpixel shading.
Every entire horn, wing, tail, tongue, staff, axe and claw must fit wholly inside its ORIGINAL equal cell, with at least 15% EMPTY TRANSPARENT padding on EVERY edge. Common lowest foot/body ground baseline at 85% cell height. Airborne offsets are game-rendered: keep lowest body edge at that baseline even for tucked flight poses. Consistent body scale across sixteen poses; the final collapsed creature stays recognizable and substantial, not tiny particles.
Every row must contain at least THREE unmistakably different silhouettes at native48. True transparent alpha. No checkerboard, opaque background, labels, words, numbers, guides, borders, shadows, ground lines, detached particles/flame specks/electrical dots, speed streaks or extra monsters. All fire/electric accents must be small flat pixel clusters attached to the body. Return the complete transparent 4x4 pixel sheet.
Row ONE four subtle, distinct IDLE poses from Slow breathing and moss/head shift. All four idle poses have BOTH hind feet/claws DOWN FLAT on the same baseline; NO raised sole, foot lift, travelling or attack in row ONE. First pose neutral, second blink/head tilt, third slow breath/appendage flex, fourth relaxed settling.
Row TWO four travel poses based on large alternating strides and strong planted weight. IMPORTANT alternating walking feet: Row TWO column ONE raises the foot on the IMAGE-RIGHT side, bent knee and visible dark sole, with IMAGE-LEFT foot down flat. Column TWO plants IMAGE-RIGHT foot while LEFT heel lifts. Column THREE must raise the OPPOSITE IMAGE-LEFT foot BEHIND the body, knee bent backwards, dark underside visible with a transparent gap beneath it, while IMAGE-RIGHT foot stays DOWN FLAT as support. Column FOUR plants LEFT foot while RIGHT heel lifts. C1 and C3 must raise OPPOSITE feet. Do not repeat the front/right raised leg in both C1 and C3. Counter-swing arms and shift hips/hem with each leg. If robed, lift LEFT hem in C3 to reveal the raised left boot. Both broad legs must be clear; raised foot has dark sole and a transparent gap, straight support leg bears the weight.
Row THREE C1 WIND-UP, C2 COMPACT strong STRIKE, C3 braced RECOVERY from Arm raises and delivers a broad strike, C4 HURT recoil from heavy recoil. Keep the action compact and the entire arm/claw/neck within the cell's central70%; no long reach into another cell.
Row FOUR four gradually lower DEFEAT poses ending in a complete substantial grounded heap based on knees buckle and the body settles into a rock mound. Every wing/horn/coral spike/fang/tail complete inside its own cell. No ground, water, splash or shadow: those are renderer effects.
